_comment: Terminal-first: `none` is a placeholder that spawns nothing and answers nothing. The room is driven by agents attaching over /mcp. Point AGUI_ROOM_PROVIDER at a real id (codex, claude-max, …) to give the room an in-page agent again; the runtime adds locally available managed ACP agents to the registry either way.

providers.label: No in-page agent. Attach from a terminal over /mcp
